{{Top}} {{Otheruses}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:ImperialSecurityOfficer-SignatureSeries2022.png]] |name=Unidentified Imperial security officer (Trask) |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[9 ABY]], [[Trask]]The events of "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]," including the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[security officer]]'s [[death]] above [[Trask]], took place in [[9 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]]. |species=[[Human]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Green |skin=Light |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Pirates again.|The security officer|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''security officer''' served in a [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. He served on an [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], which was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] above the [[moon]] [[Trask]] in [[9 ABY]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s led by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]. The security officer gave updates to the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti'' cruiser's]] [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]] and was soon ordered to begin the [[starship]]'s ascent from Trask. The security officer listened as the [[cruiser]]'s [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Trask)|deck officer]] was [[Death|killed]] trying to contain the Mandalorians. He was then present for a discussion between the ship's [[captain]] and Moff Gideon. After Gideon ordered the ''Gozanti'' cruiser to be scuttled, the security officer was promptly shot and killed by the captain, who took the officer's seat and attempted to crash the cruiser, although he was stopped by the Mandalorians. ==Biography== ===Intruders aboard=== {{Dialogue|The captain|What's going on? How many of them are there?|A stormtrooper|Hard to say. At least ten, maybe more.|The security officer|Sir there are only four life forms.|attr=The captain, a stormtrooper and the security officer discuss the intruders|src=}} During the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Era|reign]], the [[security officer]] served in a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], having the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. In [[9 ABY]], he piloted an [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], alongside a [[Unidentified Imperial freighter pilot|freighter pilot]]. The [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti'' assault carrier]] one [[Standard day|day]] visited the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] [[Trask]] when it was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s during the [[cruiser]]'s departure. While the intruders fought [[stormtrooper]]s on the [[starship]]'s outer walkways, the [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]] of the vessel made his way to the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. The security [[Imperial officer|officer]] informed the [[captain]] of the attack shortly before a [[trooper]] fell onto the bridge viewport, prompting the captain to have the bridge sealed. [[File:Trask-officers.png|thumb|left|300px|The security officer in the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier's cockpit with the captain and freighter pilot.]] The captain later questioned the number of attackers over the comms, to which a stormtrooper engaging in the fighting claimed at least ten. The security [[officer]], though, read on his terminal that four lifeforms were present, and the trooper over the comms identified them as Mandalorians before being [[Death|killed]]. After the officer reported that the intruders were heading towards the cargo bay, the captain had him and the [[freighter]] [[pilot]] begin the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier's]] ascent from Trask. ===Sacrificed=== {{Quote|What's happening.''"
"''The intruders are heading your way.|The deck officer and the security officer|}} As the cargo bay was prepared for defense, the [[deck officer]] there asked what was happening, to which the security officer filled him in that the Mandalorians were heading towards the deck officer's position. The security officer listened as the deck officer and his stormtroopers were able to isolate the Mandalorians in the cargo control area, which the intruders used to flush out the latter officer and his troopers from the ''Gozanti'' assault [[carrier]] through the cargo bay doors. The security officer exchanged looks with the freighter pilot before attempting to get a response from the cargo bay over the comms. That was when [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], the lead Mandalorian, responded, exchanging with the captain and promising to capture the assault carrier. [[File:CaptainKillsBridgeCrew-TMCh11.png|thumb|right|300px|The captain kills the security officer.]] The captain contacted Gideon, summarizing the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier's situation and requesting reinforcements while the security officer watched. Gideon, however, implicitly ordered the captain to scuttle the assault carrier, and the security officer and freighter pilot looked at each other in fear. After cutting communications with the moff, the captain drew his [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]] and shot and killed both of his officers, pushing the security officer's body onto the floor to take his seat. The captain then attempted to crash the ''Gozanti'' assault carrier into Trask, but was stopped by the Mandalorians, who took control of the bridge. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Come in. Do you copy? Do you copy?''"
"''I copy. Thanks for packing up all this gear so nicely.|The security officer and Bo-Katan Kryze|}} [[File:SecurityOfficer-ToppsChromeTheMandalorian.png|thumb|left|200px|The officer wore a standard Imperial officer's uniform, rank plaque and kepi.]] The security officer was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, brown [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s. He frequently looked to the captain or the freighter pilot when witnessing or hearing the elimination of other personnel on board the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier. After the deck officer was apparently lost, the security officer pressed for a response from the cargo bay. Upon hearing Gideon's final orders to the captain, the officer breathed heavily and looked over to the freighter pilot a final time, only for both to meet their ends at the hands of their own captain. ==Equipment== {{Quote|They're headed towards the cargo bay.|The security officer tracks the Mandalorians|}} The security officer [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Color|black]] [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and a [[code cylinder]] attached below his left shoulder. He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left [[breast]] with two red bars above two blue, which signified the rank of lieutenant.''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Bryce-Chapter11-officers.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Titus Welliver on set as the captain with director Bryce Dallas Howard and the actors of the freighter pilot and security officer.]] The security officer appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]] and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} Credited as "Security Officer," he was played by [[Philip Alexander]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 3|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 3]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-11-the-heiress|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 11: The Heiress"}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-11-the-heiress-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 11: The Heiress"}} {{Po}} *{{InsiderCite|202|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two Companion|reprint=1}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified Imperial security officer (Trask)}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Oficial de seguridad Imperial no identificado |ja=名称不明の帝国軍保安士官（トラスク） |ka=იმპერიული დაცვის უცნობი ოფიცერი (ტრასკი) }} [[Category: Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]]
